learning_outcomes.text: Explain the purpose and types of budgets
Build an operating budget from drivers and assumptions
Apply forecasting techniques including rolling forecasts
Perform variance analysis against budget and forecast
Communicate budget assumptions and risks clearly

integrative_case: A department finance lead must deliver next year's budget: build it from drivers rather than last year plus inflation, convert it into a rolling forecast, analyse the first quarter's variances by price and volume, and present the assumptions and sensitivities to leadership.
assesses: knowledge and applied reasoning on every in-scope outcome via MCQ/MR
case-based decisions in the integrative case
